# garage_cluster_layout (Data Source)

The applied cluster layout, with the result of its computation.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "garage_cluster_layout" "this" {}

output "usable_capacity" {
  value = sum(data.garage_cluster_layout.this.roles[*].usable_capacity)
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Read-Only

- `partition_size` (Number) Size of one partition, in bytes.
- `roles` (Attributes List) (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--roles))
- `staged_changes` (Boolean) Whether changes are staged and not applied yet.
- `version` (Number)
- `zone_redundancy` (Number) Null means as many zones as possible.

<a id="nestedatt--roles"></a>
### Nested Schema for `roles`

Read-Only:

- `capacity` (Number)
- `id` (String)
- `stored_partitions` (Number)
- `tags` (List of String)
- `usable_capacity` (Number)
- `zone` (String)
